company.notes: Listed since the 1986 IPO (10-K: 'traded on NASDAQ since our initial public offering in 1986'). No EDGAR filing found gives the first trading day, so ipo_date is not set; the commonly cited 1986-03-12 is unverified. Moved from NASDAQ to the NYSE (trading expected from 2013-07-15). The current registrant (CIK 0001341439, formerly Ozark Holding Inc., incorporated in Delaware in 2005) became the parent of the predecessor Oracle Corporation (CIK 0000777676, renamed Oracle Systems Corporation) on 2006-01-31 in the Siebel reorganization. Predecessor filings are cited as evidence, and director tenure is treated as continuous across the reorganization. The predecessor's 10-K says it was incorporated in Delaware in 1986 and continues operations begun in June 1977. Declassified board (annual elections). Lawrence J. Ellison is Executive Chair and CTO. Two co-CEOs (Magouyrk, Sicilia) since 2025-09-22. The lead independent director rotates annually among the F&A, Governance and Compensation chairs.

conflicts.description: Ellison's founding/director month. The 1994-2001 proxies say he has been a director 'since May 1977' (founding in May 1977). From 2003 on the proxies say June 1977, as do the 2005 10-K ('operations originally begun in June 1977') and the 2026 proxy (CEO 'from June 1977, when he founded Oracle'). Kept year precision (1977).
Boskin's start month. The 1994 proxy (his first) through the 2002 proxy say 'since May 1994'; the 2003 and later proxies say 'since April 1994'. Kept year precision (1994).
Berg's start month. The 1997 proxy (his first) through the 2002 proxy say 'since March 1997'; the 2003 and later proxies say 'since February 1997'. Kept year precision (1997).

Ellison's chairmanships. The 1995-2003 proxies say Chairman 'since June 1995'; the 2026 proxy says 'from May 1995 to January 2004'. His earlier stint is 'April 1990 until September 1992' (1994-2001 proxies) vs 'May 1990 until October 1992' (2003 proxy). Kept years for the starts (1990, 1995) and the 1992 end; the January 2004 end is uncontested.

September 2014 leadership change date. The 8-K body says the CEO, Executive Chairman and Executive Vice Chairman appointments happened on September 17, 2014, but the 8-K cover's 'earliest event reported' is September 18, 2014 (the announcement day). Kept 2014-09-17.

Ablo's announcement date. The 8-K body says Oracle 'announced' her election on March 22, 2022 (also the 8-K event date and her Form 3 event date), but the press-release exhibit is dated March 24, 2022, the day the 8-K was filed. Kept 2022-03-22 as both start and announcement date.

Form 4 relationship fields lag the September 2025 transition. Catz's 2025-10-23 Form 4 still gives her officer title as 'Chief Executive Officer', a month after she became Executive Vice Chair. Magouyrk's and Sicilia's Forms 4 through 2026-09-19 do not mark the director box, although the 8-K and both proxies make them directors from 2025-09-22. Kept the 8-K/proxy facts.

open_questions: Exact appointment days are not in any EDGAR filing for Ellison (1977), Boskin (1994), Henley (June 1995) and Berg (1997). These predate EDGAR full-text search, and the earliest proxies give at most a month, which conflicts for Ellison, Boskin and Berg.

When Boskin's current lead-independent-director stint started. The role rotates annually among the F&A, Governance and Compensation chairs and no filing dates the hand-offs. Proxy snapshots: Chizen (2019), Boskin (2020), Conrades (2021), Chizen (2022), Boskin (2023), Conrades (2024), Chizen (2025), Boskin (2026). Only Boskin's current stint is recorded, with an unknown start.

Ellison and Catz filed no Oracle Form 4 in 2026 (their latest are dated 2025-10-23). Their current service rests on the 2026 proxy (filed 2026-09-25), which renominates both. Catz's only 2026 Form 4 is for Paramount Skydance.
The exact day Henley became Chairman (January 2004) and Ellison's January 2004 end as Chairman are disclosed only to the month.
Mihaljevic (joined 2026-05-06) has no committee assignment in his 8-K or the 2026 proxy.

The 2026 proxy committee-membership table marks seats with images, so committee rows come from the text nominee table. For Panetta and Parrett they come from the 2024 proxy's nominee table: the 2025 proxy lists them only in the image table, where the tick marks (Compensation and Governance for Panetta, Governance for Parrett) agree.
Independence roles for long-tenured directors are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations, and only the 2018-2026 proxies were checked for them.
Pre-2020 directors who left before 2020 (e.g., Mark Hurd, d. 2019-10-18; Hector Garcia-Molina, did not stand in 2019) are out of scope and not recorded.

coverage.method: Roster = the 13 nominees in the 2026 DEF 14A (filed 2026-09-25; it says Mihaljevic and Rusckowski joined after the 2025 meeting and Conrades and Seligman retired in January 2026). Checked against every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 (none filed after the proxy; latest 8-K 2026-09-14) and every Form 3/4 filed from June 2025 to 2026-10-01, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed fetched 2026-10-05 UTC. Eleven of the 13 filed Oracle Forms 4 in 2026; Ellison and Catz did not (latest 2025-10-23). Magouyrk and Sicilia file as officers without the director box.

Every DEF 14A from 2018 to 2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 reviewed. Annual-meeting slates (Item 5.07, 2019-2025) compared year over year: 14 directors on 2020-01-01, 6 departures since. Departures dated from 8-K Item 5.02 (Conrades, Seligman) or from the Item 5.07 meeting date for directors who did not stand (James, Sikka, Panetta, Parrett).

Pre-2020 seats recorded only for directors serving in 2020 or later, reconstructed from predecessor (CIK 777676) proxies from 1994 to 2005, the 2001-2002 10-Q, appointment 8-Ks and Forms 3. Directors who left before 2020 are not recorded.
